scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['package-lock.json', 'yarn.lock'].forEach((f) => { try { fs.rmSync(f, { force: true }) } catch {} }); const ua = process.env.npm_config_user_agent || ''; if (ua && !ua.startsWith('pnpm/') && !ua.startsWith('npm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present --filter=!@workspace/mockup-sandbox run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter=./artifacts/** --filter=./scripts --filter=!@workspace/mockup-sandbox --if-present run typecheck
